title: AVERAGE of a fixed decimal column

source.quote: A single value of one these types: currency , decimal
source.supports: AVERAGE can return a currency, which can only be for a currency column

source.quote: Returns a decimal number that represents the arithmetic mean of the numbers in the column.
source.supports: the Microsoft page says only decimal number

derivation: V[Amt] holds 10.5, BLANK, 0, -2.25, 10.5, 4, BLANK. Sum 22.75 over 5 non-blank values: 4.55. DAX Guide lists currency among the return types, taken here to mean a currency column gives a currency.
alternative: The result is a double: the same value, 4.55, with the column type double.
notes: The value is the same under both readings; only the column type is in doubt.
